title: Changes in the risk of eating disorders and nutrition-related attitudes during university studies: A prospective cohort study of students of medicine, psychology and nutritional medicine
summary: The period of study is a formative phase for the development of long-term eating habits and is associated with an increased risk of unhealthy eating behaviour. This study aims to investigate how eating behaviour and nutrition-related attitudes change during the course of study and which factors influence this. The data will be collected using an online questionnaire.

interventions.name: In the first semester of their studies, participants receive a questionnaire on their eating habits, stress levels and attitudes towards nutrition, which they are free to complete on a voluntary basis. This survey is repeated once per semester until the end of their studies.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
First-semester student at the University of Lübeck in the following degree programmes: Nutritional Medicine (B.Sc.), Psychology (B.Sc.) and Medicine
Sufficient language skills in German or English
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient language skills in German and English
